Baseline Padel has a policy called "Child Supervision and Drop-Off" that applies to all branches. It ensures that responsibility for a child's welfare is always clearly defined between the parent or guardian and the club staff, with no ambiguous handover periods during which nobody is accountable for a minor's whereabouts.

This means you cannot leave your 6-year-old unattended at the club while you play. The club requires clear supervision responsibility for children under sixteen at all times.

If you cancel a court reservation two hours before the scheduled start time, it falls within the late cancellation window. According to Baseline Padel's Booking & Cancellation Policy, members may cancel free of charge only up to six hours before the start time. Cancellations made later than six hours before the session begins, including two hours before, are subject to late cancellation terms, which typically means you may not get a refund or may incur a charge. 

For exact details on the late cancellation terms, you may want to check the full policy or contact the club directly.
